action.anchor: SEC acceptance, not historical live receipt
action.rule: Preserve accepted choose_action: ceiling minute, RTH open+5m through close-30m, otherwise next valid session

events.issuer_sampling_key: Ascending numeric CIK AFTER monthly top-500 universe and event eligibility
events.membership_join: SEC acceptance month in America/New_York; frozen monthly membership; same dated class remains valid at SEC acceptance and simulated action time

failure_policy: No partial manifest and no success-based replacement; missing qualifying inputs or fewer than 25 qualifying issuers fails closed

freeze.scope_change: New explicit amendment and scoped re-review; original and prior scopes never overwritten

universe.bar_contract: median(previous 60 session-date Alpaca SIP 1Day raw close × Alpaca SIP 1Day raw volume)
universe.class_selection: Most liquid qualifying common class per issuer by median dollar volume; stable research ID breaks class ties
daily_semantics: Grouped by New York calendar day, timestamp at local midnight
Daily volume can include trades that do not update daily prices, including extended-hours conditions
Provider-native liquidity proxy, not RTH-only volume, official closing-price dollar volume, or actual traded dollar notional
Session dates still come from the registered market calendar; the daily bucket must have completed before the monthly cutoff
Historical retrieval preserves provider revisions; raw adjustment is not a claim of a point-in-time unrevised vendor vintage
universe.domestic: US domestic operating-company issuer, source-grounded as of cutoff; incorporation country alone is not sufficient
universe.identity: Dated research-class lineage and listing intervals; interval/source evidence predates the membership/event cutoff, historical retrieval time may be later
universe.lookback_rule: Exactly the immediately preceding 60 regular sessions, all valid; no missing-session interpolation or substitution with older sessions
universe.monthly_cutoff: 00:00 America/New_York on first calendar day of each month; inputs only from completed earlier regular sessions
universe.monthly_issuer_rank: Descending median dollar volume, then ascending numeric CIK, then research instrument ID
universe.numeric_precision: Decimal arithmetic; median of 60 is mean of the middle two ordered close*volume products
universe.population_completeness: All eligible candidates/classes for each month must be enumerated with dated source evidence before ranking; present-day symbol lists and successful-download-only rosters are forbidden
universe.prior_close_contract: Preceding session-date bar from the identical provider-native daily contract; close >= $10
universe.unknown_inputs: UNRESOLVED blocks the affected universe/scope, never removes a candidate or substitutes another issuer
